notes.title: Обновление от 03.06.2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680177/e464eef96c95d6588fa42995da88a97f93b12244.jpg[/img]

Change log:

Super Attacks added for playable characters.
Game models improved.
New enemy types added.
New trap types added.
Various creatures added to levels in Island mode.
Holes (enemy spawn points) added in Island mode.
Special indication added to characters on low health level (Island and Survival modes).
Special effect added for extra damage attacks and comboes.
Reaction to attacks improved.
Game balance adjusted.
Various bugs fixed.
Character and team names localization added.
Demo play mode added - head to head fight (inactivity in main menu for 60 sec).



[previewyoutube=dNCQQNsAb0k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Jaws & Claws - crabs
notes.content:
We are glad to inform you that now all the characters in the game can blink!
Blinking is procedural and does not depend on the current animation, or the animation editor in which it is made. This allows the effect to look cool and quite natural.
[previewyoutube=KXXId9lT1pw;full][/previewyoutube]
Winter levels have been improved.
Another type of mine has been added - a brown mine, and several types of enemies.
And there are also small crab that crawl and sometimes pinch.

notes.title: Jaws & Claws - Gazelle
notes.content:
Today we want to show you one of the bosses of our game.
It's a Gazelle.
The video shows how masterfully she deals with her rivals.
[previewyoutube=dfD2JocYSvA;full][/previewyoutube]
But that's not all.
The player will have to meet her not one-on-one, but together with her friends.
We are continuing to work on the game.
We will be able to show you the new bosses soon.

notes.title: Jaws & Claws - environment elements
notes.content:
The SPDstudio game development team is in touch.
A little news about our fighting platformer Paws&Claws.

We've done some pretty serious work and finalized a lot of small details.
Added a special effect for super punches.
All levels in the "Island" mode have been improved (new types of traps have been set) to make the game more interesting and more difficult.
Added a special designation for objects that cause damage (spikes, thorns) to draw the player's attention and prepare him for danger.
[previewyoutube=G25VJ-wtrZA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Jaws & Claws - one vs one mode
notes.content:
The SPDstudio game development team is in touch.
We continue to introduce you to the Jaws&Claws fighting platformer.

The main work on the one vs one mode has been completed.
As we planned, this will be a full-fledged fighting game mode where players need to fight against each other.
We paid special attention to the intelligence of bots for this mode. They are quite strong and are able to apply various series. In battles against each other, bots can seize the initiative in battle and practically not give the opponent a chance, even if he uses a clinch.

[previewyoutube=7TBY1gwABaI;full][/previewyoutube]
However, there are battles that are quite evenly, going neck and neck. With a constant shift of initiative from opponent to opponent.

[previewyoutube=zNBULIJkB5w;full][/previewyoutube]
As it turned out, it's quite interesting to even just look at the battles of bots. And playing is even more interesting.

notes.title: Jaws & Claws - Traps
notes.content:
We have added two new types of traps.
One is with spikes, triggered with a slight delay when the player steps on it.
The second is a trap-a board that throws the player or his enemies far back or into some dangerous place.
[previewyoutube=ttqARYtsYF8;full][/previewyoutube]
It's not just the player himself who can fall into traps. You can lure and push enemies there.

notes.title: Jaws & Claws - bosses
notes.content:
We have started creating bosses for the story mode of the game. In this news, we want to tell you small stories about the fate and hobbies of each of them.

[h1]Wily Weasel[/h1]
[h3]Big Boss[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680177/ed74c1114b3f7b95284352ca50ebe0b3d1001cd0.jpg[/img]

Showman and TV presenter. The author of the bestseller "Pyramid". Political figure, People's Deputy of the first convocation.
Professor of Economic Analysis. A seven-time champion in fights on fingers. Former mayor of Fero City. Head of the National Security Council.
The author and owner of the show "Jaws & Claws". Founder of the Space Corporation  Jupiter J. The author of the bill "fixed taxes". Is the President of the Shadow Government Corporation.
Animalrubles billionaire, an investor. 18th place in the Cross list. A fighter for a healthy lifestyle. He has no bad habits.
He loves painting And beautiful women. The character is disgusting. There are no children. Not married.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680177/5305b3d00974e55cafbb3d7737ba01d01ca6a4c6.png[/img][/td]
        [td]
[h1]Fossa[/h1] 
Is a brilliant surgeon, partner and right hand of the Wily Weasel.

As a child, Fossa, like all girls, played a mother's daughter and a doctor with patients. The dream of becoming a doctor came to her quite early and did not leave her child's head for a minute anymore. Fossa read medical literature avidly. She attended various medical seminars and forums.
Even before graduating from school, she knew the structure of the animal body perfectly. She graduated from the medical institute with honors, and performed dozens of successful operations during her residency. It seemed that Fossa was destined to play the role of the greatest savior of animals. That's exactly how it was up to a certain point.

[expand type=details]
At one of the scientific conferences, Fossa met a Cat. He was handsome, smart and gallant. They quickly began an affair, which soon ended with the wedding of two brilliant doctors-scientists. They were the perfect couple in an ideal world of scientists.
However, the spouse had unusual predilections in bed. He loved to conduct experiments that plunged him into a near-death state, he said that in this way he gets indescribable pleasure. One day, a couple in love switched from using suffocating or stabbing devices to medically diving into a coma. As a result, the Cat's body could not stand it and Fossa's husband died. Since then, she has not been able to forgive herself for the loss of a loved one. She was afraid to perform operations on children, accusing herself of incompetence. Fossa retired from medicine and moved to Slonovia.
One day, while drinking in a bar, Fossa witnessed a shootout with a large number of victims.
Without a second thought, using improvised means, the woman saved a large number of animals wounded in the shootout. The Wily Weasel couldn't help but notice this and invited her to his place of work.
Cutting and stitching up criminals on the verge of life and death did not scare Fossa. Now she could save animal lives again. For which she was infinitely grateful to the Wily Weasel.
[/expand] 

She has been cutting up wounded prisoners for more than 10 years and will save their lives.
The companion and right hand of theWily Weasel in business.
He likes to hurt and heal animals.
There are no children. Widow.
       [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680177/a1397a42e59d212c97b5ec4d729418deb170153c.png[/img][/td]
        [td]
[h1]Fox[/h1]
The most professional fighter is a mixed martial arts champion.

She spent her childhood in a Medvezhancy.
After graduating from school, Lisa moved with her parents to south Pandai.
According to the parents of the future kickboxing champion, Pandai had the strongest martial arts schools. Lisa loved playing sports. At the same time, she attended the wushu, sambo, boxing and taekwondo sections. Sometimes her training was interrupted only for sleep.

[expand type=details]
Lisa wanted to be the best fighter on the planet. Numerous victories in competitions have become a natural result of the intense training of the Fox.
She did not take winning the official women's championships as proof of her absolute skill. As a result, the Fox moved to Slonovia to participate in the championships without rules. In general categories with men. The first fight against the Rhinoceros, the multiple champion lost. It was the first defeat of the Fox in her life. The girl realized that in order to win fights without rules, she needed to train even more.
During the day she worked as a bartender, and at night she went to the most criminal neighborhoods to smash the noses and break the bones of the district leaders. At one of these showdowns, she was spotted by a Wily Weasel.
The genius villain offered the girl what she dreamed of - appointed her his bodyguard and the head of a criminal gang. Now all the best fighters were selected for the team of the Wily Weasel only through the Fox.
The girl could continue to improve her art, thanks to endless sparring, with almost any number of fighters. And now she's happy.
[/expand] 

She has been working for the Wily Weasel for about 7 years.
She loves fish oil, disco music and inflicting minor injuries on her rivals.
There are no children. Not married.
       [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41680177/ac19f79bd56722b19a8c724db08becd0535af4b6.png[/img][/td]
        [td]
[h1]Gazelle[/h1]
The most beautiful bodyguard and Weasel's girlfriend.

She was born in a small town in the south of Volchalia. Since childhood, she was a very beautiful and modest girl. I dreamed of becoming an actress. Upon coming of age, she went to Slonovia to get on the big screens.
That's how the time came for Gazelle to go through endless castings for minor roles, which ended in refusals.

In parallel, the girl took part in beauty contests and was able to win one of them. It was a widely publicized media contest organized by Duck Dump. The winner was spotted by a Hyena who persuaded her to participate in bonobo-streams.

[expand type=details]
Easy money turned the beauty's head and released her internal brakes. The girl decided that she was ready to try herself as an actress in leming-films. Filming brought money, but there was no happiness and fame, which Gazelle had dreamed of since childhood.
All this has affected her psyche. Anger at the world around her has become her calling card. And the image of a man for a gazelle was an ATM with short legs.

At one of the night parties, Gazelle met a Wily Weasel. The beauty immediately fell in love with him. Why this happened has become a mystery even for the Gazelle. Perhaps the vile character of the Weasel played a decisive role. According to Gazelle, they are made for each other with the object of her adoration.
[/expand] 

She has been working for the Wily Weasel for about 5 years and is incredibly devoted to him.
She loves everything pink and unusual toys.
There are no children. Not married.
        [/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

notes.title: Jaws & Claws - tutorial mode
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!

It's SPDstudio development team.
For three years we've been making cool platformer-fighter Jaws&Claws.
And now we have a bunch of news about it for you.

In the fictional universe populated with antropomorphic animals a brutal TV-show exists. 
It's participants are sent to dangerous island and compete for survival and money prize.
'Jaws&Claws' is a mix of a genre such as platformer, fighter, beat'em up, party game.
Gameplay is full of fights, shootouts, action and rivalry.
The game has unique visual style and catchy carachters.
OST represents hard'n'heavy with funk and electronics elements.
Various game modes can attract many players.

[previewyoutube=UpGmftVIqPM;full][/previewyoutube]

We've almost completed Tutorial mode, so you can easily learn features of the gameplay.
Soon we are to release demo-version of Jaws&Claws, so everybody can try out our game.

[previewyoutube=7KupnuKnhuE;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll keep posting the most valuable news about our project here.
